{{Current events header|2016|10|11}}

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2015–present)|War in Afghanistan]], [[Violence against Shia Muslims]]
**A gunman, reportedly wearing an [[Afghan National Police|Afghan police]] uniform, kills at least 14 people and wounds dozens more in the [[Shia Islam|Shiite]] Karte Sakhi shrine in [[Kabul]] on the beginning of [[day of Ashura|Ashura]]. Police kill the attacker. [http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2016/10/11/At-least-14-killed-by-gunmen-in-Kabul-mosque-at-start-of-Ashura/9921476204127/?spt=hs&or=tn_int (UPI)], [http://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-attacks-idUSKCN12B2E1 (Reuters)]
*[[Rohingya insurgency in Western Myanmar]]
**In a third day of fighting, an attack in [[Rakhine State]] kills four [[Myanmar Army|Myanmar soldiers]]. [http://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-37627498 (BBC)]
*[[Yemeni Crisis (2011–present)|Yemeni Crisis]]
**The [[Obama administration]] through the [[United States Department of Defense|U.S. Defense Department]] says it will take appropriate action against those responsible for October 9 unsuccessful cruise missile attack, apparently fired from [[Houthis|Houthi-controlled]] territory in [[Yemen]], upon the [[USS Mason (DDG-87)|USS Mason]]. [http://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-pentagon-idUSKCN12B2DB (Reuters)]
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**The [[Syrian Observatory for Human Rights]] and a [[National Coalition for Syrian Revolutionary and Opposition Forces|rebel official]] report that [[Russia]]n jets have resumed heavy bombing, and, in total, have now killed at least 50 civilians in villages surrounding rebel-held eastern [[Aleppo]]. [http://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-aleppo-idUSKCN12B14M (Reuters)], [http://news.sky.com/story/aleppo-airstrikes-kill-at-least-50-civilians-in-rebel-held-areas-10614275 (Sky News United Kingdom)]

;Business and economy 
*[[Samsung]] announces an end of production of the [[Galaxy Note 7]] after continued problems with its battery. [http://www.theverge.com/2016/10/11/13202608/samsung-galaxy-note-7-discontinued (The Verge)]
*Following the [[Brexit]] vote and the subsequent drop in the exchange rate of the [[Pound sterling|British pound]] to [[United States dollar|U.S. dollar]], the [[FTSE 100 Index]] reaches an all-time intra-day high of 7,129. [http://news.sky.com/story/ftse-100-hits-record-high-as-pound-weakens-below-123-10613252 (Sky News United Kingdom)]
*[[Computer security]] firm [[Symantec]] warns a second hacking group, going by the name Odinaff, is trying to rob banks using fraudulent [[Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication|SWIFT]] messages, the same approach that yielded U.S.$81 million in [[2016 Bangladesh Bank heist|February's attack on Bangladesh's central bank]]. So far, the group has infected 10 to 20 organizations with this  [[malware]]. [http://www.reuters.com/article/us-cyber-heist-malware-idUSKCN12B1L3?il=0  (Reuters)], [http://www.investopedia.com/news/symantec-finds-new-attacks-swift-users-symc/ (Investopedia)]

;Disasters and accidents
*A residential building collapses in the eastern [[China]] city of [[Wenzhou]], leaving at least 22 people dead. [http://www.cnn.com/2016/10/10/asia/china-building-collapse/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Hurricane Matthew]]
**The [[United Nations]] launches an [[Effects of Hurricane Matthew in Haiti|emergency appeal]] for almost U.S.$120 million in life-saving help for 750,000 survivors in [[Haiti]] at risk of [[starvation]] and/or [[cholera]]. [http://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/hurricane-matthew/haiti-needs-massive-response-halt-cholera-crisis-after-matthew-u-n664191 (NBC News)]

;Health
*[[2015–16 Zika virus epidemic]]
**The [[World Health Organization]] warns that the [[Zika virus]] will continue to spread across [[Asia]] with cases already reported in [[Singapore]] and [[Thailand]]. [http://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-37615427 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*The [[Supreme Court of the United States|U.S. Supreme Court]] hears arguments in a patent dispute between [[Apple Inc.]] and [[Samsung]] concerning both company's smart phone designs (Samsung Electronics v. Apple (15-777)). [http://www.reuters.com/article/usa-court-iphone-idUSL1N1CG0HZ (Reuters)]
*The [[Obama administration]] through the [[U.S. Department of Justice]] announces that they will file criminal contempt of court charges against [[Maricopa County, Arizona]] sheriff [[Joe Arpaio]] for violating a judge's order to stop immigration patrols that led to a court finding of racial profiling. The charges carry a maximum penalty of six months in jail. [http://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2016/10/11/497577585/feds-will-press-criminal-contempt-charges-against-ariz-sheriff-arpaio (NPR)], [http://www.azcentral.com/story/news/local/phoenix/2016/10/11/department-justice-charge-arpaio-criminal-contempt/91901204/ (''Arizona Central'')]
*The Office of the Chief Medical Examiner in [[Oklahoma City]] reports that an unarmed black man, [[Shooting of Terence Crutcher|Terence Crutcher]], shot dead on September 16, by a white police officer, Betty Jo Shelby, had [[Phencyclidine|acute PCP intoxication]]. Authorities charged her with first-degree manslaughter. [http://www.foxnews.com/us/2016/10/11/autopsy-oklahoma-police-victim-had-pcp-in-system-when-died.html (AP via Fox News)]

;Science and technology
*Astronomers announce that [[2014 UZ224]] is the third most distant [[Solar System]] object known from our [[Sun]], currently over 90 times the Earth's distance from the Sun (90.8 [[Astronomical unit|AU]] or 8.44 billion miles), after [[Eris (dwarf planet)|Eris]] (96.2 AU) and [[V774104]] (~103 AU). [http://www.minorplanetcenter.net/mpec/K16/K16TA4.html (The International Astronomical Union Minor Planet Center)]
